notes: Piezo In: MIDI velocity reworked. It now follows how hard the piezo is hit across the full MIDI range, independent of the audio gain setting, with new velocity_curve, velocity_min and velocity_gain controls. New retrigger_mask stops one tap sending several notes, and the trigger has a 30 ms minimum hold. New broadband_trigger mode (with trigger_hpf) for stick and knock hits. The clip indicator no longer fires falsely at high gain. USB MIDI Out is retired: use MIDI Out with Output set to USB; existing patches are converted automatically. Includes all changes since 1.10.103.
